title: What Gen knew about Chun-Li's father in Street Fighter
subject: chunli
description:
Should Gen have told her everything? 👇

The dying assassin who knew Chun-Li's father, and the secret he kept from her. Spoilers for Street Fighter Alpha and Street Fighter IV.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: The one man who knew the truth was a dying assassin.
His name was Gen, an old friend of her father's and a master of two killing styles.
In Street Fighter Alpha, he sparred with Chun-Li and gave her a single name: Shadaloo.
Years later, in Street Fighter IV, she tracked him down again. "Tell me everything you know about him!"
Gen wouldn't say another word about her father.
Then Vega triggered the self-destruct at the S.I.N. dam, and Gen shielded her as it fell.
He saved her life, and he still never told her the whole story.
